label: Form as cause: a non-concrete esse cause holds and an actual contingent concretum is ungrounded
paraphrase: Closed control on one interpretation (two mutually accessible worlds; a non-concrete item existing at both and a concrete item existing at the selected world only; the non-concrete item causes the concrete item's esse; empty selected relation): the non-concrete-cause rival holds; every actual contingent concretum participates esse; whatever participates esse has a distinct cause of its esse; and it is false that every actual contingent concretum has an actual concrete ground. A statement about this interpretation only.
